name: Biblioteca Gnóstica Universal
description: Ultra-Fast Offline-First Digital Gnostic Library and Metaphysical Study Suite featuring instant native book reader, editorial typography (EB Garamond), zero-data caching, astronomical deep-space imagery (JWST), and sacred ambient audio.
constraints: External Project Write Barrier Active (LEVEL 2 Authorized for Native Offline Reader)
Strict Offline-First capability (LocalStorage reader state, Cache-First PWA)
Near-zero mobile data consumption (< 150 KB per book vs 30 MB PDF)
WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility & editorial typography standard
Dual-mode reading (Native Offline Reader + Official AGEAC/VOPUS Iframe)
risks: External iframes to vopus.org/ageac.org break when disconnected (mitigated by Native Reader fallback)
Uncompressed PDFs in public/pdfs total 111.8 MB (isolated from precache)
assumptions: Modern mobile browser supports Service Worker Cache API and LocalStorage
Reading progress is persisted locally per book ID
owner: Biblioteca Gnóstica Leadership / EOS Control Plane
